'''JediMaster124 The D.S.S.D.''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[JediMaster124]]
* '''Published:''' 22 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Lord, Is That Legal?|Cor-D-mylordisthatlegal.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' My Lord, Is That Legal?
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Legal JediMaster124 DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is my senate deck.
